description: This file defines interfaces for user settings management and notifications within the WPEFramework, including methods for setting and getting various user preferences such as audio description, language, captions, privacy, parental controls, and viewing restrictions.

classes.name: IUserSettings
classes.description: Interface for managing user settings such as audio description, language preferences, captions, privacy, parental controls, and watershed settings.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for receiving callbacks when user settings change.

classes.name: IUserSettingsInspector
classes.description: Interface for inspecting migration states of user settings, especially during component upgrades or data migration.

classes.name: SettingsMigrationState
classes.description: Structure representing the migration state of a specific user setting key.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for user setting changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Set preferred audio languages as a comma-separated list.

methods.name: SetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Set presentation language in BCP 47 format.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Get current preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: SetPinControl
methods.description: Enable or disable parental pin control.

methods.name: SetViewingRestrictions
methods.description: Set viewing restrictions via JSON document.

methods.name: SetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Enable or disable live watershed rules.

methods.name: SetPlaybackWatershed
methods.description: Enable or disable playback watershed rules.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Enable or disable blocking of not rated content.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Retrieve blocking of not rated content setting.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Enable or disable PIN requirement on purchase.

methods.name: SetHighContrast
methods.description: Enable or disable high contrast mode.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Enable or disable voice guidance hints.

methods.name: GetMigrationState
methods.description: Check if a specific setting key requires migration.

methods.name: GetMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieve migration states for all settings keys.
